issues.location: proof labels in the implication-introduction/elimination detour
issues.finding: The prose assigns delta_1 both to a proof of A and a proof of A implies B, while the displayed A branch repeats delta_2, already used for the B-from-A branch. The intended distinct proof labels are delta_1 for A and delta_2 for B from A.
issues.proposed_resolution: Keep delta_1 on the proof of A, omit the conflicting label on the whole implication proof, and label the displayed A branch delta_1.

issues.location: informal statement of the normalization subformula property
issues.finding: The stated result-only subformula property omits undischarged assumptions: a normal derivation from an open assumption may contain formulas not occurring in its conclusion. The chapter proves intuitionistic normalization, so the informal claim also needs that scope.
issues.proposed_resolution: State the subformula property for intuitionistic natural deduction relative to undischarged assumptions or the conclusion.

translation_treatment: The target keeps the detour, normalization and cut-elimination argument while correcting the two proof labels and narrowing the subformula claim. The frozen English file is not changed.
